partially_covered.missing: No data properties for Organization attributes (e.g., name, tax ID, contact info). Only structure for organizations and their roles is present.

cq_coverage.details: All CQs except CQ5 are structurally supported by classes and properties. CQ5 (organization information) remains only partially covered as no descriptive data properties were added for Organization. Other CQs are fully answerable with the current ontology.

strengths: Good use of disjoint unions for roles
All object and data properties are well-typed and labeled
weaknesses: No use of GCAs or equivalence axioms for complex class definitions
No data properties for organization or item descriptive attributes

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7: Missing descriptive data properties for core entities

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add data properties to Organization for name, tax ID, and contact information to fully support CQ5.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables queries about organization details and completes CQ5 coverage.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce cardinality restrictions and general class axioms (GCAs) to enforce business rules (e.g., every Invoice must have at least one InvoiceItem, one BuyerRole participation).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Increases logical rigor and validation of EDIFACT invoice structure.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand EDIFACT technical vocabulary with additional segment, element, and code instances, and link them to relevant business semantics.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves technical completeness and coverage for EDIFACT scenarios.

summary: The ontology continues to provide strong coverage for almost all competency questions and maintains good OWL 2 compliance and modeling discipline. However, the most critical gap from the previous review—lack of descriptive data properties for organizations—remains unaddressed, leaving CQ5 only partially covered. No new quality improvements or modeling enhancements were observed in this iteration.

suggestions_ignored: Add data properties to Organization for name, tax ID, and contact information to support CQ5.
Introduce restrictions and GCAs for business rules.
improvement_tracking.notes: No substantive changes were made since the last review. Major improvement suggestions were not implemented, resulting in stagnant quality and coverage scores.
